value.text:
Checking for additional dispatch functions that may have been missed.

Four memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks:

- created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
- updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
- deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
- comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook

All four converge at webhook.PostAsync. That function delegates to webhook.Post for actual delivery.

DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook also calls webhook.PostAsync directly. PostAsync enqueues jobs for workers that invoke Post for actual HTTP delivery. The four dispatch functions are located in internal/webhook/webhook.go.

Four dispatch functions are in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. They all call `webhook.PostAsync`, which enqueues jobs. Workers then call `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` to deliver the webhooks.

The delivery path is `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`.

q30.
memos.memo.created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memos.memo.updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memos.memo.deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memos.memo.comment.created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
webhook.PostAsync → webhook.Post in internal/webhook/webhook.go

All four dispatchers live in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Created/updated/deleted go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comment-created posts itself. Both paths call `webhook.PostAsync`, and the async workers deliver with `webhook.Post`.
